basis: R00 (release-audit-v1.1): A01 frozen-fixture byte drift + W01-W05 final-model-message loss + E01-E04 scorer coercion. retainedNotes: The 0/24 repair frozen-test outcomes remain true failures of the workspace state as it then was, but 'failures are model refusal, not harness' is NOT supported by this data (audit report line 47).
Search-layer A/B recall numbers (A2/A3) remain valid: they never depended on the model chat loop; only agent-outcome and repair-outcome attribution is invalidated.
